title: Digital Marketing
tagline: Master online marketing, SEO, and social media growth.
description: Learn how brands actually get found, chosen, and remembered online — SEO, paid advertising, content, and social media, tied together with the analytics to prove what's working. Built around running real campaigns, not memorizing marketing terms.
outcomes: Plan and run SEO and paid ad campaigns
Build and grow a brand's social media presence
Analyze campaign performance with analytics tools
Write content and copy that converts

topics: Plan and launch a mock ad campaign
Present a full marketing plan with metrics

projects: Run a mock paid ad campaign with a budget and targeting plan
Build an SEO content plan for a real or sample business

faqs.q: Do I need a marketing background to start?
faqs.a: No — the program builds from the fundamentals up to running real campaigns.

faqs.q: Will I get hands-on ad platform practice?
faqs.a: Yes — you'll set up campaigns directly in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, not just review screenshots.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
